Aria: Quick flag — small but consistent BLEU drop (~1.1) when bringing mistral-lite-q3 into canary for SRT/subtitle-style testsets (speaker labels + timestamps). Artifacts: https://console.redwood.ai/evals/63678 :mag:
Diego: Minimal repro please? SRT examples can be finicky.
Aria: Tiny repro below (Japanese SRT snippet):
```
1
00:00:12,000 --> 00:00:15,000
[Ken] 今日は。
```
Baseline float tokens: ["[","Ken","]","\u3000","今日","は","。"]
q3 tokens:             ["[Ken]00:00:12,000","\u3000今日","は。"]  <-- timestamp merged into bracket, ideographic space attached
SCORES: fp32 BLEU 29.7 -> q3 BLEU 28.6. Token mismatch concentrated on cue/timestamp/bracket cases (~0.9% of set).
Soo-Min: Did you try tokenizer normalize variations and kernel traces?
Aria: Repro commands I ran:
```
python eval.py --model mistral-lite-q3 --tokenizer-args "normalize=NFKC" --input sets/srt-ja.srt --save-tokenized out/q3_tokens.json
python eval.py --model mistral-lite-fp32 --tokenizer-args "normalize=NFKC" --input sets/srt-ja.srt --save-tokenized out/fp_tokens.json
```
Ran with REDWOOD_KERN_TRACE=1. Trace (fast q3 path) shows: select(srt-fuse) -> prepack -> srt-strip-timestamp -> attach-bracket -> emit. Compatibility path: prepack -> emit -> srt-strip-timestamp.
Diego: That ordering will change byte slices the tokenizer sees. Try q3 + REDWOOD_QUANT_BACKEND=compatibility and q3 + REDWOOD_DISABLE_SRT_FUSE=1.
Aria: Ran both: q3+compat -> BLEU 29.3, q3+DISABLE_SRT_FUSE=1 -> BLEU 29.4. Token mismatch drops to ~0.25%.
runtime-bot: Canary mistral-lite-q3 started for eng-ml at 2026-05-05T08:12:10Z (canary id c-63678)
Soo-Min: Likely cause: an aggressive "srt-fuse" optimization on the quant fast path that folds timestamps/brackets to reduce emission. It didn't account for tokenizer normalization semantics around ideographic spaces and bracketed speaker tokens.
Diego: I'll kick off kernel bisect and add a unit test with SRT cues, timestamps, ZWSP, and ideographic space. ETA 48h.
Aria: I'll run a cross-locale SRT sweep (ja/zh/ko) and gather token-id diffs to estimate blast radius. ETA EOD.
Soo-Min: Ops: prepare a short-term canary rule to fallback to compatibility backend when input matches `\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2},\d{3}` or contains bracketed speaker labels.
runtime-bot: Canary scaled to 10% (mistral-lite-q3) for eng-ml at 2026-05-05T09:03:01Z
Aria: Will attach diffs and a tiny repro harness. Thanks all :pray:
